items.storyText:
Have you got a milkshake, Rosy? Yes, I have.

Where's Billy? He's behind the tree.

Has he got a cheese sandwich? No, he hasn't. And he hasn't got his salad.

Here you are, Billy. Thank you.

Billy. Do you like the food? Well … they like the food.

Sorry, Mum. Naughty birds! Don't worry. We've got more food.
